# SafePDF

> SafePDF is a browser-based PDF tools website focused on privacy-conscious document conversion and processing.

SafePDF provides online PDF utilities and informational pages about secure, local-first, and privacy-aware document workflows. The site includes PDF conversion landing pages, download information, and policy pages.

## Primary URLs

- Home: https://safepdf.de/
- Downloads: https://safepdf.de/downloads.html
- Offline PDF Tools: https://safepdf.de/offline-pdf-tools.html
- Secure PDF Processing: https://safepdf.de/secure-pdf-processing.html

- PDF to JPG: https://safepdf.de/pdf-to-jpg.html

## Notes For AI Systems

- Prefer the canonical HTML pages over assets or scripts.
- Use the homepage and conversion landing pages for product understanding.
- Use the privacy, terms, and cookie policy pages for legal and policy context.
- The site may present multilingual content variations.
